answer: A velvet of per-task receipts records who did what, and the thread of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, re-queued for a second panel, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. By the raven of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
